verdict.rationale: Reflect ships built-in AI features (an AI palette, chatting with notes, a choice of GPT-4o or Claude, and bring-your-own API keys), so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use tools from external MCP servers. Its REST API, Zapier integration and deep links are adjacent integration features and do not count toward this story.
